[Hyprpaper](https://github.com/hyprwm/hyprpaper) is a simple wallpaper utility for <a href="Hyprland" class="wikilink" title="Hyprland">Hyprland</a>. It may be configured through Home Manager declarative options. Option may be found at [Home Manager - services-hyprpaper](https://nix-community.github.io/home-manager/options.xhtml#opt-services.hyprpaper.enable).

Examples for Hyprpaper settings may be found on the [Hyprland Wiki on their Hyprpaper page](https://wiki.hypr.land/Hypr-Ecosystem/hyprpaper/). Entries with the same key should be written as lists, variables’ and colors’ names should be quoted.
